label: access()
type: the sync-function helper that grants a user (or, when the argument is prefixed 'role:', a role) access to one or more channels. Effects from every active document's access() calls are combined in a union - once any document has ever granted a user a channel, no other document's sync-function invocation can revoke it (only channel()-side routing changes or REST-API/role changes can). Cannot grant the all-channels wildcard - the REST API's channel-grant endpoint is the only way to do that.
note: First dedicated reference page for a function round 3's combined sync-function.json only summarised; corroborates and sharpens round 3's finding rather than contradicting it.
